criteria.description: One consistency ruleset per pack file kind in packs.domain.rules (graph, artifact, asset, step, prompt slot, fragment, mission type); descriptor/format are reader prechecks; glossary and asset escape are edge checks (S2, WP06 D1/D2).
criteria.evidence: GraphRulesTest#thePlantsExpectedFindingsAreTheOracle:189, AssetRulesTest, StepRulesTest, MissionTypeRulesTest, FragmentRulesTest, PromptSlotRulesTest, DescriptorChecksTest; PackRulesets.java:14-28
criteria.notes: Acceptance criterion (from spec.md): Each pack file kind with consistency checks (graph, artifact, asset, step, prompt slot, fragment, mission type) has one ruleset in packs.domain.rules, and each of today's checks is a rule of exactly one of them; the descriptor and format checks are the one reader's prechecks, and the glossary and the asset escape have no domain rule.

criteria.description: Rules composed under names with no surface profile: content(), holding(), registration()=holding().must(content()); membership is a plain gate; verdict() is one Rationale in registration's wire order.
criteria.notes: Acceptance criterion (from spec.md): PackRulesets.content(), StorageRulesets.holding() and StorageRulesets.registration() = holding().must(content().on(TreeRead::contents)) exist as named ModularRulesets with no surface profile or mode flag; manifest membership runs only when the read faults and registration() found no violation; verdict() returns one Rationale in registration's wire order, so registration's findings are a subset of validate mode's.

criteria.description: CLOSURE (CompositionRules.closure()) reports every composition fault with today's codes; the offering keeps its first refusal in today's order with its pack list.
criteria.notes: Acceptance criterion (from spec.md): PackRulesets.closure() over the composition facts of a set of packs with levels reports every duplicate-id, dependency (cycle, unknown, out of range), parent, level and conflict fault with today's codes, and a valid set on the same fixture reports nothing; the offering still refuses with its first fault in today's order and its pack list.

criteria.description: Classification, precedence/ordering, path checks and manifest membership stay plain functions rules call.
criteria.evidence: Precedence, Paths, DescriptorChecks in domain.rules; StorageRulesets.manifestMembership:85; PrecedenceTest, PathsTest, StorageRulesetsTest$Gate
criteria.notes: Acceptance criterion (from spec.md): Classification, ordering and precedence, and the manifest set difference are plain functions that rules call, not rules or compositions of their own; FR-001's and FR-002's tests cover them.

criteria.description: Validate mode is PackCheck in pack-validation: one PackReading read, read.rationale().and(placement), mapped by PackVerdicts; names only packs.domain and the kernel.
criteria.notes: Acceptance criterion (from spec.md): PackCheck in pack-validation runs the one read through the PackReading port its caller supplies and returns read.rationale().and(placement().check(placement)); a load-only fault that validate mode missed before is found; PackCheck names only packs.domain and the kernel, and the service runs no pack-validation main code.

criteria.description: Registration reads the staged tree once through PackReading and refuses via PackRefusals before assembly; loadStaged(readout) assembles with no second read.
criteria.notes: Acceptance criterion (from spec.md): A registration reads the staged tree once through PackReading and refuses through PackRefusals when the readout's Rationale fails, before PackAssembly builds the aggregate; a reader-only fault is refused before assembly with one read, and packs.application names no storage type.

criteria.description: PackFinding/PackElementViolation/RefusalViolation converters deleted: no shim, no Surface table; PackElementViolation stays as the aggregate's record (WP13 ruling).
criteria.evidence: git grep over service for PackPolicy|PackFindingCode|PackFindingb|enum Surface|violationOf|findingOf|violationKind|toRefusal|toDiagnostic finds none; PackPolicy*/PackFinding tests deleted
criteria.notes: Acceptance criterion (from spec.md): The converters between PackFinding, PackElementViolation and RefusalViolation are deleted with no shim or per-surface code table: a search for the converter methods returns nothing.

criteria.description: Two edge mappers keep each surface's order: PackRefusals (packs.application) and PackVerdicts (pack-validation); neither in packs.domain.
criteria.notes: Acceptance criterion (from spec.md): Two mappers exist, each at its edge: PackRefusals (packs.application) maps the verdict to the API problem and its diagnostics, PackVerdicts (pack-validation) to the validate-mode verdict; each keeps its surface's order, and neither lives in packs.domain.

criteria.description: Every code is a typed ReasonCode owning its severity, built once in PackCodes/StorageCodes/PlacementCodes; the specific code wins over a catch-all per the R2 table.
criteria.evidence: PackElementViolation.java:13; PackCodesTest:38,76; VocabularyEqualityTest; PackCodesCoverageTest (reflective); HexagonalArchitectureTest PACK_CODES_HAVE_ONE_OWNER:1968-1990
criteria.notes: Acceptance criterion (from spec.md): Every code is a typed ReasonCode that owns its severity and wording; one fault answers one code on every surface (R2 table), the specific code wins over a catch-all, and validate mode answers the specific code registration already answers.

criteria.description: An unmodelled file, nested shard or charter.yaml is a file_not_held warning: not held, not round-tripped, not judged by validate mode; globs narrowed under a ### Breaking line.
criteria.notes: Acceptance criterion (from spec.md): A pack with a file no pack file kind models is accepted with one file_not_held warning naming the file, and neither the stored pack nor the round trip carries it; the unmodelled violation code is gone; validate mode reports the same warning and judges nothing in the file; a nested *.graph.yaml and a charter.yaml are unmodelled under the packs contract's ### Breaking line.

criteria.description: The graph rule calls slice F's RelationshipEndpointRule bridge; relationship_endpoint_not_allowed unchanged.
criteria.notes: Acceptance criterion (from spec.md): The graph rule calls slice F's endpoint bridge, and #515's check answers relationship_endpoint_not_allowed, unchanged, from PACK.

criteria.description: One test class per rule and per mapper plus PACK composition tests, each in its subject's module; parity-by-hand tests gone.
criteria.evidence: 13 classes under packs/src/test/.../domain/rules; storage rules tests; PackCompositionTest:113-284; PackRefusalsTest; PackVerdictsTest
criteria.notes: Acceptance criterion (from spec.md): There is one test class per rule and one per mapper, plus a PACK composition test for each gate, suppression or precedence interaction; the order and wording functions keep their whole tests; each test lives in its subject's module.

criteria.description: Records follow the code: ### Breaking fragments (Q1, R2, S2, S8), packs CHANGELOG, rewritten scenarios, ADR-0075/0062/0065 amendments, #554 and #478 texts.
criteria.evidence: contracts/charter/changes/2026-11-16-*.md, 2026-11-17-*.md; ADR-0075:126; ADR-0065:66; ADR-0062:365; research/issue-drafts/554.md, 478.md (posted at closeout)
criteria.notes: Acceptance criterion (from spec.md): The records say what the service does: the ### Breaking fragments for Q1, for registration's and validate mode's R2 changes and for S2's gains; the packs ### Breaking line for the narrowed globs; the rewritten scenarios; the ADR-0075 amendment; the ADR-0062 and ADR-0065 annotations; and #554's and #478's issue texts amended.

criteria.description: A draft open-packs issue covers unmodelled->file_not_held, the narrowed charter.yaml/nested-shard classification, and the R2/S2 code changes.
criteria.notes: Acceptance criterion (from spec.md): The Mission research holds the open-packs draft research/open-packs-drafts/TBD-unmodelled-not-held.md covering the unmodelled-to-file_not_held change, the narrowed charter.yaml and nested-shard classification, and the R2, S2 and S8 code changes, ready for the orchestrator to file.
